entries.reason: Open-ended blackboard scalars stay dynamic in memory but persist through typed DynamicValue fields instead of JSON strings.
entries.schema: eve.decision.proto.DecisionContextSave with scalar_values in each Blackboard.
entries.version: Version 3 writes typed scalars; version 2 remains readable for binary and Protobuf JSON migration.
entries.migration: Version 2 scalar_json entries are parsed once into dynamic runtime values; original version-1 JSON retains its compatibility importer.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively, and dynamic scalar decode rejects invalid kinds and non-finite values.
entries.restore_atomicity: Every board, state, transition and grid is validated in a detached DecisionContext before authoritative maps are swapped.

entries.reason: The public binary snapshot stays the canonical persistence face; script JSON methods remain compatibility entry points.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this internal format revision.

entries.thread_affinity: The caller owns the DecisionContext and performs snapshots and restores outside concurrent mutation.
cost_notes: Capture and restore cost linear time in boards, scalar bytes, transitions and grid cells.
